$comment: Completion bar for #30: only UTF-8 was read (UTF-16 SRT failed to import), a blank line inside an SRT cue dropped the rest, bad timestamps collapsed to 0, chunkCues assumed sorted input (end<start spans), and companion discovery missed .en-US.vtt/.eng.srt/upper-case extensions. Fix: decodeCaptions (UTF-16LE/BE BOM + NUL heuristic) wired into all three caption reads; parseTimestamp returns null on invalid input (invalid start skips the cue, invalid end becomes zero-duration at the valid start); parseSrt/parseVtt preserve in-cue blank lines; chunkCues sorts first; findCompanionCaptions covers regional/.eng/upper-case extensions and returns the true on-disk name. The notesNear scan-on-every-timeupdate sub-item (previously declared uncovered) is now covered by #69, which throttles scans to one per 2s (notesNearAtRef). Criterion 1 fails before (decodeCaptions did not exist); 2 runs the media smoke fixtures; 3 asserts the #69 throttle landed; 4-5 guard typecheck and build.
